'''Icefish''' were a species of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to [[Ediorung]]. They were considered a delicacy and were often [[Fishing/Legends|caught]] or poached as a result.<ref name="cswe" /> They were often served on a bed of [[Ramorean capanata]], and [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] was fond of creating such a dish for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|his master]].<ref name="TfJP">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>
